text:
sam: quick heads-up — saw double charge on streaming + toolcall when client reconnects mid-stream.

sam: steps: open stream, issue tool call mid-response, force client reconnect, reconnect uses resume token; console shows provisional tokens spike, ledger shows toolcall counted twice.

lara: :eyes: can you drop the minimal logs/repro?

sam: pasted logs below:
```
_2026-03-20T03:11:12Z_ session=abcd resume_token=rt-123 toolcall_id=null toolcall_payload_hash=0x8f3
server: emitting suffix chunk with toolcall credits
client reconnect -> resume -> server replays buffered suffix -> emits toolcall again
ledger: provisional + confirmed both incremented
```

metrics-bot: alert: provisional_token_spike model=redwood-base pct=2.1% at 03:12 UTC

dmitri: initial thought: our resume path replays buffered toolcall frames without idempotency guard when call_id is null.

dmitri: if client supplies call_id we dedupe using (session, call_id) but older SDKs omit it on reconnect.

lara: two lines of attack: server-side dedupe heuristics OR require SDK changes. we should avoid breaking older SDKs.

irene: proposal: server dedupe heuristics for N seconds based on (session_id, toolcall_hash_prefix, suffix_seq) and emit tracelet indicating dedupe decision. also add telemetry tag 'toolcall_replayed'

ben: drafted PR for dedupe + telemetry. question: how does this interact with quota accounting? if we dedupe after provisional was already emitted, do we rollback provisional or mark as refunded?

lara: do not auto-refund. auto-refunds are risky for billing/SLAs. Console should expose 'provisional vs confirmed' and allow ops to issue a refund/adjustment with audit trail.

sam: agree. console UX: add a filter 'provisional spikes' and link each spike to session trace and ledger events.

ben: for quotas: provisional tokens should still count towards soft quotas but be flagged; refunds should not increment customers' monthly usage but should decrement provisional counter. Add metric 'provisional_to_confirmed_ratio' and alert threshold.

lara: specific thresholds: provisional_ratio > 1.5% for 5m triggers page, >5% auto-open ticket. Ops can then run refund flow.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: canary-redwood-1 with dedupe heuristics at 09:00 UTC :shipit:

sam: small canary OK. after 24h, if provisional_drop > 50% and no false-dedupe incidents, roll to canary-redwood-2.

dmitri: I'll add an integration test that simulates reconnect + missing call_id to ensure dedupe doesn't drop legitimate retries.

irene: also need docs for SDK: recommend including call_id on toolcalls; make it backward-compatible; add migration note in console release notes.

lara: sounds like action items: ben PR, dmitri tests, irene telemetry+docs, sam run canary. I'll open a follow-up thread with rollout plan. thanks :thumbsup:
